summary: Direct extraction and inspection of the rebuilt NSIS installer, confirming the Post-Service Observability Report's get_service_report command is genuinely compiled into the shipped binary, alongside every prior phase's still-unaffected symbols.
buildCommand: scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh, unchanged from Phase 4.4 (--features whisper,semantic-search) - no new native dependency was introduced this phase.

installerChecksum.sizeChangeNote: -884 bytes (~0.006% smaller) - expected: this phase adds one small, purely additive read-only module (service_report.rs) with zero new crate dependencies; the tiny net decrease is normal build-to-build NSIS/compression variance, not a regression.

cipDesktopExeVerification.newSymbolsDirectProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings against the extracted cip-desktop.exe confirms 2 occurrences of the literal string 'get_service_report' (one in the invoke handler's command-name table, one elsewhere in the string pool). x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm confirms the mangled function symbol cip_desktop_lib::commands::get_service_report, plus Serialize-impl symbols for the four new service_report.rs structs (SuggestionStats, DetectionKindCount, TimelineCategoryCount, LiveDiagnosticsSnapshot) and drop-glue for ServiceReport and its Vec<DetectionKindCount>/Vec<TimelineCategoryCount> fields - direct proof this phase's code is genuinely compiled into this exact binary, not just present in source. build_service_report itself was inlined into get_service_report's compiled body by the release-mode optimizer (a single call site, the classic inlining case) - its own drop-glue for intermediate iterator closures is still separately present and matches the expected type signature.
cipDesktopExeVerification.newCommandRegisteredProof: 'get_service_report' appears contiguously in the invoke handler's registered command-name table, immediately after 'get_service' (the command it sits next to in commands.rs and lib.rs's generate_handler! list) - the same literal-string-concatenation registration pattern every prior phase's command registration proof has used.

priorPhaseSymbolsUnaffected.whisperFullWithState: 96 occurrences of 'whisper_full_with_state' - identical count to the Phase 4.4 baseline, confirming the whisper feature/model pipeline is untouched by this phase's changes.
priorPhaseSymbolsUnaffected.finalizeBibleOnly: 1 occurrence of 'finalize_bible_only' (Phase 4.3's fast detection lane) - unchanged, still present.
priorPhaseSymbolsUnaffected.getEmbeddingCapabilities: 2 occurrences of 'get_embedding_capabilities' - identical to the Phase 4.4 baseline.
priorPhaseSymbolsUnaffected.allMiniLmL6V2: 2 occurrences of the literal model identifier string 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2' - identical to the Phase 4.4 baseline, confirming the semantic-search feature's model-selection code is untouched.

runtimeDllVerification: scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh's own final step (7z-extraction DLL-presence check) passed unmodified on this build: 'confirmed: libstdc++-6.dll, libgcc_s_seh-1.dll, libwinpthread-1.dll are all present in the installer' - service_report.rs uses only rusqlite/chrono/serde, all already linked, so the runtime DLL set required is unchanged from every prior whisper-enabled build.
crossCompileVerification: The Rust build (cargo build --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p cip-desktop --features whisper,semantic-search --release) succeeded with the same two pre-existing whisper-rs-sys fixes (ggml lib-naming, posix-threads alternative) as every prior Windows rebuild - zero new fixes were needed for this phase's purely additive, dependency-free module.
automatedVerification: Full pipeline (Rust cross-compile, frontend build via vite, NSIS packaging via makensis, DLL-presence check) completed via a single run of scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh with no manual intervention beyond the standard root/update-alternatives permission the script already documents needing.
